text:
Ana: Quick kickoff — we have a partner co-marketing slate for CloudFjord listing + joint benchmark blog + webinar. Need alignment on: marketplace copy, benchmark narrative, webinar date + format, inbound lead routing, and messaging A/B test.

Mike: timeline?

Ana: aiming for 4-week runway. cloud catalog listing ready week 2, benchmark blog draft week 3, webinar week 4. Is that realistic? @Mike @Sarah

Mike: ok. I'll own landing page & demo asset. Need final hero copy and logo files by EOD Tue. :thumbsup:

Sarah: for inbound, prefer routing to 'cloud-inbound' SDR queue. We need map: marketplace leads -> SFDC Campaign 'CloudFjord Co-Marketing' and source=marketplace.

Jamie: putting proposed routing rule here:
```
route: {
  source: "cloud_marketplace",
  destination_queue: "cloud-inbound",
  sfdc_campaign: "CloudFjord Co-Marketing",
  utm_source: "cloudfjord",
  priority: "high"
}
```
Will wire up HubSpot -> SFDC sync.

Liam: webinar messaging — two angles: "Benchmark: 2x inference cost savings" vs "How we cut latency 40% in real apps". Recommend A/B test subject lines on the registration page.

Ana: agree. We'll A/B on hero and subject. @Jamie please add UTM params: ?utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=cloudfjord

OpsBot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1805550000-cloudfjord-co-marketing-webinar (organizers: Ana, Mike) :calendar:

Ana: sweet. Action items: Mike (assets + landing copy by Tue), Jamie (routing + UTMs), Sarah (SFDC mapping + QA), Liam (subject variants). Weekly check-in Friday 10am. Thanks all :raised_hands:
